slides.title: Capacity is the forecast
slides.sub: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud revenue roughly doubles by 2028, if the power arrives on time.

slides.text: for AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, up from a *$440bn* run-rate today.
slides.source: SOURCE: FRINGELINES HYPERSCALER MODEL · RUN-RATE = Q3 2026 REVENUE × 4 ($184BN + $133BN + $123BN)

slides.title: Capex is up 6–13× since 2020
slides.source: SOURCES: FILINGS, GUIDANCE, SELL-SIDE CONSENSUS (~OCT 2026) · CALENDAR-YEAR PARENT CAPEX, MICROSOFT INCL. FINANCE LEASES

slides.title: Money is fast. *Power is slow.*
slides.text: That's the new AI capacity the world may need in 2027 alone. AWS plans to double its power by end-2027, Google adds ~7 GW in 2027, and Microsoft targets 38 GW by 2032.
slides.source: SOURCES: EXPONENTIAL VIEW (27–41 GW ESTIMATE); COMPANY GUIDANCE

slides.title: Same capex. *Two quarters late.*
slides.text: In the power-gated Bear case, 36-month revenue falls 15% at AWS, 17% at Azure and 24% at Google Cloud versus Base. Timing matters more than the size of capex.
slides.source: SOURCE: FRINGELINES HYPERSCALER MODEL · BEAR VS BASE, Q4 2026 – Q3 2029
